text:
Sam R.: Quick sync: MeridianCare renewal 07/01 — procurement raised a billing entity mismatch. Need to resolve before onboarding expansion. :eyes:
Nina P.: What mismatch?
Omar K.: PO issued to Meridian Health Inc but our contract invoices MeridianCare LLC. PO# MC-2023-77.
Jules T.: They want to add 20 seats (current 40 -> 60). Training team needs headcount confirmed to schedule.
Sam R.: Sales wants price hold for existing 40 seats, addons at list. Finance says they can't process with mismatched entity.
Nina P.: Fastest path is reissued PO. Alternative is a one-page invoice-entity amendment via DocuSign (takes ~48h).
procure-bot: Suggested buyer text:
"Please reissue the PO naming 'MeridianCare LLC' (EIN: 98-7654321) as billing entity and reference MC-2023-77. If reissue isn't possible, please confirm who can sign an invoice-entity amendment."
Omar K.: Asking procurement now. Also buyer requested net60; finance capped at net45.
Jules T.: We can tentatively hold one onboarding cohort the week of 6/27 if PO or amendment is confirmed by 6/24.
Sam R.: Plan: request PO reissue today; if not, prepare one-pager amendment and fast-track exec sign. Omar, please confirm timeline with buyer.
Omar K.: Sent: "Can procurement reissue the PO to MeridianCare LLC (EIN included)? If not, we'll send a one-page DocuSign amendment to align invoice entity and keep your training slot."
Nina P.: Finance note on proration for seat add-on (example):
"20 seats * $120/seat = $2,400 prorated for effective month if add-on goes live 7/1."
Sam R.: Include that line in the quote and amendment. Training quote separate.
procure-bot: DocuSign template queued: AMEND-BILLING-ENTITY-1P v1. Will merge prorate and EIN when numbers are provided.
Omar K.: Buyer replied asking for a sample invoice displaying our billing tax ID. Requesting PDF now.
Nina P.: Uploading sample invoice with billing EIN and addresses. Sending to buyer.
Jules T.: Buyer says procurement can reissue by EOD once they have the sample invoice and final headcount. Holding cohort as "pending PO".
Omar K.: PO reissued and attached: MC-2023-77-REISSUED.pdf (billing entity = MeridianCare LLC). Forwarding to finance.
Sam R.: Awesome. Once finance confirms, we finalize seat add-on and lock onboarding. Thanks team. :tada:
